description: This file defines Pydantic models used for API data validation and serialization in a document classification/dashboarding system. It includes models for rules, uploads, dashboards, templates, schedules, classification results, and insights.

classes.name: RuleCondition
classes.description: A single atomic condition in a rule for document tagging/classification.

classes.name: ClassificationRuleEntity
classes.description: Represents a rule for classifying/tagging documents after parsing.

classes.name: RuleCreateEntity
classes.description: Request model for creating a classification/tagging rule.

classes.name: RuleUpdateEntity
classes.description: Request model for updating an existing rule.

classes.name: DashboardConfigCreateEntity
classes.description: Request model for creating a dashboard config.

classes.name: DashboardConfigUpdateEntity
classes.description: Request model for updating dashboard dashboard.

classes.name: TemplateCreateEntity
classes.description: Request model for creating a dashboard template.

classes.name: TemplateUpdateEntity
classes.description: Request model for updating a dashboard template.

classes.name: ClassificationResultEntity
classes.description: Represents the result of a classification/tagging process.

classes.name: InsightSummaryEntity
classes.description: Summary insight entity for reporting trends/outliers/highlights.
